question: 因为质量问题退货最多的商品是哪个
gold_sql: select p.product_name from refunds r join order_items oi on r.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id where r.reason = '质量问题' group by p.product_name order by COUNT(distinct r.refund_id) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE r.reason LIKE '%质量%'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 1
